title: HtmlB
responsibility: Renders the native b element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlB.attributes
inputs.description: Native b attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlB.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native b element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlB
outputs.description: The actual native b element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
